description:
Blue Sea Fishery — English Translation
Version 1.3.1  |  Starsector 0.98a-RC6

Ballistic firepower, carrier groups, combined arms — and maybe a little fishing.

>> Download v1.3.1 (English) <<

This is a full English translation of Blue Sea Fishery, a ballistics-and-carriers faction mod by Qingzhuo Wuyue and team. Everything the player sees has been translated: ships, weapons, hullmods, descriptions, dialogue, missions and the mod's hardcoded text. Nothing about the gameplay has changed.

What's Included

English text for all ships, fighters, weapons, ship systems, hullmods, skills, factions, missions, skins and rules dialogue
Hardcoded text inside the mod's JAR translated, including intel, industry and hullmod tooltips
Leftover { } brackets removed from in-game text
Crash fix: renamed a music file whose special-character filename failed to load on English systems
German Shepherd wing description corrected to match its real flux-dissipation bonus

Screenshots & Gameplay

Older gameplay clip (Starsector 0.95a-RC15, Chinese UI). This translation targets 0.98a-RC6.

Installation

Download BlueSeaFisher_1.3.1_EN.zip.
Delete any existing Chinese BlueSeaFisher folder from your mods directory. Both versions use the same mod ID.
Unzip the download into Starsector's mods folder.
Enable Blue Sea Fishery in the launcher.
If you are switching from the Chinese version, start a new save.

Requirements

Starsector 0.98a-RC6
LazyLib
GraphicsLib
MagicLib
Optional: Nexerelin (adds the faction's Nexerelin content)

Known Issues

The Great Sea Battle mission may have a background display issue.

Credits

Original mod: Qingzhuo Wuyue and the Blue Sea Fishery team (original thread on Fossic)
English translation: MrPossible
Source / issues: GitHub repository

Found a typo or untranslated line? Post it below or open an issue on GitHub.
